message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have successfully retrieved the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My next step is to identify the times when both of them are available for a 30-minute meeting. After that, I will communicate these common availabilities to Brad so he can cross-reference them with the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.

First, I will meticulously go through the calendars for next week (Monday, November 16 to Friday, November 20, from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM) and list all the 30-minute slots where neither Priya nor Marcus has a scheduled event.

After compiling this list of common free slots, I will use the `append_workspace` function to post it to our shared log. My message to Brad will clearly state these available times and ask him to find a slot that also works for Elena and David.

This approach ensures a clear and efficient division of labor. I'm handling my part, and I'm setting Brad up to do his. Once he gets back to me with a confirmed time, I can proceed with booking the meeting.
